facts.text: I am looking to learn new techniques to improve my guitar playing.
I have been focusing on blues and rock music lately.
I am particularly interested in improving my string bending technique.
I bought a new overdrive pedal from Guitar Center last Saturday.
I have had my acoustic guitar, a Yamaha FG800, for about 8 years.
My Yamaha FG800 has been a great companion for songwriting and camping trips.
I am thinking of experimenting with effects pedals to add texture to my acoustic sound.
I am thinking of trying out acoustic-specific pedals.
I am considering the LR Baggs Venue DI.
I am considering the Pedaltrain Nano Acoustic pedalboard.
I have heard that LR Baggs products are specifically designed for acoustic guitars.
I have heard that the Pedaltrain Nano Acoustic pedalboard is compact and has a built-in DI box.
I want recommendations for acoustic guitar accessories that could help improve my tone and playing experience.
